title: grindmn inner-ring spacer (part 10) - machining
_comment: Front is section A-A through the axis (y = 0); picks lie on section-face edges at (x, 0, z). Axial steps on the -x side from the bottom face. Single picks in the top view are diameters of circles seen from above.
notes: 303 stainless. Faces parallel 0.01. Bears on the top 608 inner ring only.
General tolerance ISO 2768-mK, linear +-0.1, angles +-0.5 deg; all edges 0.3x45; Ra 1.6 on fits, 3.2 elsewhere.
